what.summary: Operator surfaced a new product direction in chat: anyone can start an org, anyone can join, no email required, roster shows founder first then chronological joiners. Two chips locked the architecture: configurable-per-org abuse-resistance posture (joining policy lives in each org's auth tree) and substrate-decision deferred (operator will pick between three substrates after reading the brief). Brief lays out all three substrates side by side (Option 1 org auto-publishes roster / Option 2 org pre-signs open policy / Option 3 hybrid) with honest trade-offs. Adds a Phase E (5-7 sessions, ~2-3 weeks) to PLAN.md Phase 8 alongside the existing A-D arc from the canonical Tapscript brief, framed as a NEW axis (membership-acquisition) parallel to the existing org-control axis. Zero new cryptography; Phase E1 extends the AuthRule discriminated union with a new join-rule kind, the rest reuses the shipped disclosureProof primitive and the Phase B verifier (when it lands).

why.text: Operator's chat framing ('Can we make where any one can start an org and anyone can join one no need email required') named three properties at once. Two were already shipped (anyone can start, no separate login needed) and the brief confirms that explicitly. The third (anyone can join) is a NEW direction extending MYCELIUM_NETWORK_SPEC §6 along an axis the spec did not previously cover. Authoring the brief tonight while the architectural context is fresh produces a cleaner artifact than batching it for tomorrow.

confidence.uncertainty: The three substrate options are honestly summarized but each has design-decision surface area that only surfaces during implementation — Option 1's roster-publication frequency, Option 2's verifier-side directory problem, Option 3's precedence rule when both proofs exist. Phase E4's UI design under Option 2 or 3 is non-trivial because there's no canonical roster artifact to display. Phase E1 (join-rule shape) is independent of substrate choice and could ship first. Phase B (verifier) is a hard prerequisite for Phase E4 and should land first to avoid duplicating verifier work.
